checks.note: connect-app page documents an OAuth 2 flow (auth code exchanged for access token, refreshed as needed) and 24h product-limited test tokens. Scopes and OAuth token lifetimes are not on that page. Search snippets say each endpoint lists OAuth scopes. Bearer is a reasonable label for the tokens, but this page doesn't use that word.

Access-tiers page confirms Trial requires approval and has daily per-app limits, with Pins and boards visible only to the creator. Standard needs a video demo showing OAuth and live integration, and it is reviewed with an emailed decision. It confirms the Sept 14, 2026 PINNER_DATA_ACCESS_DENIED note. It gives no review timeline. Multi-week-wait claims are unverified.

The access-tiers page does not say the API is REST. The v5 reference page fetched had only navigation text. Search snippets for the v5 docs describe broad coverage: pins, boards, ad accounts, campaigns, catalogs, with read and write scopes. That supports the breadth but doesn't say 'REST'. REST is not directly confirmed by a fetched page. Evidence URL should be the v5 reference.

Pinterest's own developer site describes the official Pinterest MCP Server (repo pinterest/mcp-server). It is not yet launched ('Be the first to know when it launches'). The sample config lists https://api.pinterest.com/mcp, but the page doesn't confirm that it is active.

ready_with_caveats is consistent: approval gating and the Trial-to-Standard review are real. The MCP is announced but not live, which the blocker already states. Arguably 'blocked' until approval, but it is a free developer account with documented REST-style endpoints, so the caveats label stands.

corrected.one_liner: Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where users save and organize Pins on boards, with advertising and catalog tools for businesses.
corrected.auth_notes: Documented OAuth 2 authorization-code flow (redirect URI must match app profile; code exchanged for access token, refreshed as needed). Product-limited test tokens (expire after 24h) skip the OAuth flow and are usable only after Trial approval. Scope list and OAuth token lifetimes not verified from the fetched pages.
corrected.access_notes: Developer account is free, but the app must be approved by Pinterest for Trial access before credentials/test tokens work. Trial is limited (Pins/boards visible only to creator as sandbox entities; daily per-app rate limits). Production use requires an upgrade to Standard via video demo of the OAuth flow plus live integration; the vendor page says requests are reviewed regularly, with an emailed decision and no published timeline. Community reports of multi-week waits are unverified. Apps registered on or after Sept 14, 2026 may get 403 PINNER_DATA_ACCESS_DENIED on boards/Pins for non-business users without Pinterest authorization.
corrected.blocker: Manual app approval for Trial, then manual Standard-upgrade review (video demo) needed for real production use; Trial is rate limited and restricted. Official MCP is announced (repo pinterest/mcp-server) but not launched; the endpoint is only shown in a sample config.
